summary: The Noonline SLA is intentionally treated as a reversible concept: public access, field evidence, maintenance, safety and official-boundary precision must be reviewed by people before any phase or service claim advances.

dimensions.label: data privacy and evidence integrity
dimensions.note: AI-assisted service and public feedback could be mistaken for permission to collect personal or location data, while field evidence could be falsely automated.
dimensions.mitigation: Use only public or authorised material, prohibit AI field verification, and retain verifier, timestamp and evidence-reference requirements.

dimensions.label: implementation complexity
dimensions.note: The concept crosses public-realm, station/property-interface, accessibility, maintenance and controlled-test conditions that cannot be resolved by a single design drawing.
dimensions.mitigation: Use Phase 0 verification, reversible pilots, explicit stop conditions and professional deepening only at confirmed interfaces.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, public-realm, traffic, accessibility, safety, property-interface and operations professionals must review each affected interface before it advances.

dimensions.label: public acceptance
dimensions.note: Test-facing activity, wayfinding changes and AI-assisted interpretation may conflict with users who need quiet, direct and non-digital access.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep a clear public bypass, fixed physical information, human enquiry and a documented stop or feedback path.

dimensions.label: operations and maintenance burden
dimensions.note: Signs, rest or water provision, staffed fallback and evidence recording create recurring maintenance and staffing obligations that are not yet funded or assigned.
dimensions.mitigation: Activate only components with a named maintenance and service-window record; otherwise downgrade or remove the component.
dimensions.human_review: The future operations and maintenance custodian must confirm maintainability, service window and failure response before Phase 1 activation.

dimensions.label: policy and approval uncertainty
dimensions.note: Official boundaries, detailed controls, station interfaces, heritage constraints, traffic approvals and operating permissions are unavailable or require separate confirmation.
dimensions.mitigation: Keep all geometry and interventions conceptual, use provisional-boundary labels and hold Phase 2 work until the relevant professional and official evidence is available.
dimensions.human_review: Planning, heritage, transport, legal-compliance and relevant management bodies must review before any permanent or regulated intervention is proposed.

dimensions.label: public-space and access dispute
dimensions.note: A claimed connection may conflict with a closed entry, non-public frontage, constrained clearway, unsafe crossing or competing daily use.
dimensions.mitigation: Survey access and crossings, preserve clearways, reroute to a verified public edge and suspend the continuity claim when a conflict remains.
dimensions.human_review: An authorised field verifier and public-realm/accessibility professional must review the conflict record and alternative before reactivation.

dimensions.label: technology maturity and AI-off resilience
dimensions.note: AI may be unavailable, misleading or unsuitable for a real public interface; concept testing does not establish dependable operation.
dimensions.mitigation: Put physical route logic, fixed wayfinding and human fallback before the AI layer, then exercise the failure response with AI off.

dimensions.label: equity, accessibility and no-phone inclusion
dimensions.note: A route that depends on a phone, inaccessible detour, uncertain shade, unavailable rest/water or absent human help can exclude older people, disabled people, visitors and workers.
dimensions.mitigation: Require accessible-route, entry, crossing, rest/water and staffed-fallback verification before a public-service claim expands.
dimensions.human_review: Accessibility professionals, public-service operators and affected user representatives must review field evidence and the non-digital fallback.

purpose: Connect each reversible work package to a proposed accountable role, non-financial resource band, spatial reference, verification gate, stop condition and failure response.
claim_boundary: This register proposes delivery controls only. It names no appointed organisation, approved budget, land right, procurement route, permit, construction programme or governmental commitment.

resource_bands.scope: authorised observation, access/interface confirmation, maintenance mapping, risk review and evidence record
removable wayfinding, temporary stay-space kit, human fallback procedure, content maintenance and public feedback

resource_bands.name_zh: 专业深化与受监管界面资源带
resource_bands.scope: traffic, accessibility, heritage, fire, utility, safety, station/property interface and durable public-realm design

concept_roles.name_zh: 公共空间试点统筹角色
concept_roles.responsibility: hold the work-package gate, stop an affected pilot and convene cross-interface review
record field evidence with verifier, timestamp and reference; AI cannot perform this role

concept_roles.name_zh: 公共空间与无障碍专业角色
concept_roles.responsibility: assess clearway, crossing, accessible alternative, stay-space safety and durable interface design
confirm maintainable signs, water or rest provision, service window and failure response

concept_roles.name_zh: 场地或站城界面承接角色
concept_roles.responsibility: confirm the relevant public entry, operating interface, access constraint and escalation route

concept_roles.name_zh: AI 服务与隐私监督角色
concept_roles.responsibility: ensure AI remains optional, explainable, privacy-bounded and removable without loss of physical service
concept_roles.must_be_named_before: Phase 1 when an AI layer is activated

work_packages.name_zh: Level 1 固定导向、清晰带与支持点预留
work_packages.name_en: Level 1 fixed wayfinding, clearway and support reservations
work_packages.start_gate: A legal public walking interface, clearway condition and maintenance contact are recorded for the selected segment.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: Physical guidance remains legible during an AI-OFF exercise and does not reduce the documented clearway.
work_packages.stop_condition: Public passage is blocked, the marker cannot be maintained, or the selected interface is not public or lawful.
work_packages.failure_response: Remove or relocate the component; do not count it as support or service continuity.

work_packages.start_gate: A test window, public bypass, buffer condition and responsible interface contact are confirmed by an authorised record.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: The pilot separates testing from a legible public clearway and retains a human answer path when AI is off.
work_packages.stop_condition: Testing occupies pedestrian passage, the safety buffer fails, permission is absent or the public bypass is inaccessible.
work_packages.failure_response: Suspend the test-facing interface and retain only verified public wayfinding or reroute.

work_packages.name_zh: AI 原点公共知识客厅
work_packages.start_gate: Public entry, content rights, maintenance route and a human enquiry role are confirmed for the selected activation window.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: Fixed bilingual interpretation and a human fallback remain usable without phone, screen or AI.
work_packages.stop_condition: Entry is closed, content cannot be maintained, or no accountable human fallback is available.
work_packages.failure_response: Withdraw the interactive layer and retain only authorised, maintainable physical information.

work_packages.name_zh: 大钟寺到达至日常服务转换
work_packages.start_gate: The relevant station-facing or public interface, legal crossing and accessible alternative are recorded by authorised field observation.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: Arrival, crossing, short stay and human enquiry work as a documented physical sequence without direct-station-access overclaim.
work_packages.stop_condition: The crossing is unsafe or inaccessible, detour is unacceptable, interface access is not public, or no operating role exists.
work_packages.failure_response: Reroute to a verified public edge or suspend the transfer continuity claim.

work_packages.start_gate: A named concept role is converted to an appointed service contact, with service window, physical information and maintenance record for each activated point.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: A documented AI-OFF exercise confirms that a person and physical information can resolve the declared public-service failure.
work_packages.stop_condition: The service window, physical sign, water/rest provision or responsible human role is unavailable.
work_packages.failure_response: Downgrade the service statement, post a physical alternative where authorised, or stop the activated point.

work_packages.start_gate: Lawful access and an authorised human verifier are available; the evidence ledger identifies the applicable route and node tasks.
work_packages.acceptance_gate: Every claimed promotion condition has a human verifier, timestamp, evidence reference and a recomputed engine record.
work_packages.stop_condition: Evidence is missing, stale, rejected, inaccessible to audit or written by an AI actor.
work_packages.failure_response: Retain or downgrade the verified SLA, correct the design record and never auto-promote a service claim.

phases.decision: record evidence and interfaces before physical pilot
run reversible pilot only at confirmed interfaces
expand only with sustainable responsibility and retained audit evidence

risks.name: public access or interface not confirmed
risks.trigger: entry, access right or operating interface cannot be recorded
risks.control: hold or reroute the affected work package

risks.name: clearway, crossing or accessibility failure
risks.trigger: passage blocked, crossing unsafe or accessible alternative unacceptable
risks.control: stop activation and return to verified public edge

risks.name: heat, shade, rest or water claim unsupported
risks.trigger: required midday evidence remains unknown or rejected
risks.control: retain Verified SLA at B or below

risks.name: maintenance or staffed fallback unavailable
risks.trigger: no service window, maintenance contact or physical fallback
risks.control: downgrade or remove the activated component

risks.name: testing conflicts with public safety or privacy
risks.trigger: buffer, permission or safe bypass is absent

risks.name: AI layer creates opaque or exclusionary public service
risks.trigger: physical or human fallback is removed, unavailable or less usable
risks.control: disable AI layer and retain non-digital service

risks.name: provisional geometry is mistaken for approval or construction control
risks.trigger: a concept boundary, route or node is cited as official or buildable
risks.control: correct the claim and require professional/official data
